notes.title: Cally's Trials on sale & Cally's Caves 4 Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Cally's Caves 3 and Cally's Trials are on sale for 80% off during the Steam Winter Sale.  In addition to this, Glass Wing, a game by CC contributor Sayuri is also on sale, and to celebrate, Sayuri made this awesome image of Cally and Mayfly having some snacks! 

[img]https://i0.wp.com/callyscaves.files.wordpress.com/2016/12/milk-and-orange-slices.png[/img]

We also want to let everyone know that we are working our butts off on Cally's Caves 4, and that it will be out sometime in 2017.  We are overwhelmed by the support for the Cally games, and are doing our best to make the best Cally game yet!  
Thanks to the Steam Community, and a huge thanks to Valve for letting us sell our game on Steam!
Jordan & OHKO

notes.title: Cally's Trials Steam Key Fan Art Competition
notes.content:
[b]Cally's Trials is releasing on Steam today![/b]   To celebrate, we are going to run the same type of steam key giveaway for anyone that wants to make a fan art of the Cally crew.  Here are the rules:

1) Make an original fan art of your favorite Cally game character, or group of characters
2) Post it on Twitter, let us know you are posting it for the Cally's Trials Steam Key giveaway, and tag us with @callyscaves
3) We will DM you a steam key!  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25220101/ae8824f67e9ef8b0ac04409a62194891c05be65f.png[/img]

notes.title: Streamers - Get an early copy of Cally's Trials now!
notes.content:
With the release of Cally's Trials one week away, we teamed up with Dietrich Online Services to make it easy for Youtubers, Twitch streamers, etc. get copies of Cally's Trials now.  If you want to play Cally's Trials on your channel, just go [url=https://dietrichonlineservices.promoterapp.com/pub/press/cally-s-trials] here	[/url] and enter your email and we will get you a copy of Cally's Trials promptly!

We will also be running a fan art contest once the game is out, where anyone that takes the time to make a fan art of Cally, or any of the game's characters can get a key for free.
